description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Clone that extends another attribute definition class, acting as a wrapper around a clone object to generate cloned attributes. It primarily implements a cloning behavior for attribute definitions within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Clone
classes.description: A dummy attribute definition class that mimics another AttrDef and generates clones of it using the make method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with another AttrDef instance to be cloned.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Delegates validation to the wrapped clone attribute definition.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Returns a clone of the wrapped AttrDef object.
